description: This file contains functions and procedures for upgrading platform firmware on Gemini-based devices, including checking partition layouts and performing firmware upgrades

methods.name: gemini_check_redboot_parts
methods.description: Checks the partition sizes and names for the redboot firmware partitions to verify correct layout before upgrade

methods.name: gemini_do_platform_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by extracting files from a tarball and writing them to respective MTD partitions

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines whether the device is supported for upgrade based on board name

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Orchestrates the upgrade process based on board type, calling partition check and upgrade functions
